newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian govmt worker wage bill rises 95 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Indian govmt worker wage bill rises 95 bln rupees.

text.p: India agreed on Friday to sharply raise government workers' salaries in a move that will cost 95 billion rupees annually, but rejected a plan to cut jobs in its mammoth civil service, a government spokesman said.
He said Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's cabinet accepted the Fifth Pay Commission's recommendations relating to pay scales and allowances of government employees.
But the cabinet rejected proposals to raise the age of retirement beyond 58 years, to increase the working week to six days from five at present, and to abolish overtime pay.

The spokesman said the government also turned down the panel's recommendation to cut 350,000 jobs -- a preliminary step towards eliminating more than a million jobs over the next decade. The federal government currently employs some 3.7 million people.
